title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
description: A curated selection of Boston University's most effective study environments, ranging from silent library floors to collaborative student centers across the Charles River Campus.

cards.title: Riverview Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Mugar Memorial Library, 1st Floor
cards.notes: Find a seat at the long tables for a quiet atmosphere with views of the Charles River. This silent zone is ideal for deep focus and long reading sessions.
cards.short_summary: A silent, scenic study hall on the first floor of BU's main library overlooking the Charles River.
cards.evidence_claim: The Riverview Reading Room is located on the 1st floor of Mugar Memorial Library and is designated as a silent study zone.
cards.source_title: Study Rooms & Spaces | Libraries - Boston University
cards.access_notes: Open during regular library hours; BU ID required for entry after 8:00 PM.

cards.title: Kilachand Hall 9th Floor Lounge
cards.subtitle: 91 Bay State Road
cards.notes: Access panoramic views of the Boston skyline and Fenway Park. This space features a quiet study room and a larger common area for residents.
cards.short_summary: A top-floor residential lounge offering 360-degree city views and dedicated quiet study areas.
cards.evidence_claim: The ninth floor study lounge at Kilachand Hall offers panoramic views and is available 24 hours a day to on-campus residents.
cards.access_notes: Restricted to on-campus residents; BU ID required for swipe access.

cards.title: Pardee Management Library
cards.subtitle: Questrom School of Business, 3rd Floor
cards.notes: Utilize the team rooms or open seating in this modern, well-lit space. It is specifically designed for business research and collaborative group work.
cards.short_summary: The primary library for the Questrom School of Business, featuring collaborative team rooms and quiet zones.
cards.evidence_claim: Pardee Management Library is located on the third floor of the Questrom School of Business and offers four reservable team rooms.
cards.source_title: Pardee Management Library – Open Study Spaces - Boston University
cards.access_notes: BU ID required for entry; team rooms must be reserved via the Student Study App.

cards.title: The Commons at HTC
cards.subtitle: 808 Commonwealth Ave, 2nd Floor
cards.notes: Study in an open, light-filled environment designed for community connection. The space includes a meditation room and various meeting nooks.
cards.short_summary: A spacious, multi-purpose common area in the Howard Thurman Center for Common Ground.
cards.evidence_claim: The Howard Thurman Center's new location at 808 Comm Ave features the Commons (Room 205) and other open study areas.
cards.source_title: What to Do at the New HTC | Howard Thurman Center for Common Ground
cards.access_notes: Open to all BU students during building hours; no reservation required for general seating.

cards.title: Educational Resource Center (ERC)
cards.subtitle: Yawkey Center, 5th Floor
cards.notes: Reserve a private room with a whiteboard for focused group sessions. The center also offers open-concept seating for individual work.
cards.short_summary: A student support hub on the 5th floor of the Yawkey Center offering private and open study spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: The ERC at the Yawkey Center for Student Services has private rooms available on a first-come, first-served basis.
cards.source_title: The Best Places to Study for Finals - Boston University
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday 9 AM - 5 PM and Sunday 12 PM - 7 PM; BU ID required.

cards.title: Pickering Educational Resources Library
cards.subtitle: 2 Silber Way
cards.notes: Visit this quieter library in the Wheelock College building for a more intimate setting. It features a reservable quiet study room for up to 3 people.
cards.short_summary: A specialized library for education and human development with quiet, small-scale study options.
cards.evidence_claim: Pickering Library provides a reservable Quiet Study Room and a Classroom/Study Lounge that functions as a study space when not in use.
cards.source_title: Group Work and Quiet Study Spaces » BU Libraries | Boston University
cards.access_notes: Open during regular library hours; quiet study room bookings are limited to 3 hours.

cards.title: SEL Group Study Alcove
cards.subtitle: 38 Cummington Mall
cards.notes: Book this open-door alcove for quick collaborative meetings. The library also offers quiet study areas in the lower level for individual work.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated collaborative space within the Science & Engineering Library (SEL).
cards.evidence_claim: The Science & Engineering Library offers a Group Study Alcove that can be reserved for up to 2 hours per day.
cards.access_notes: Reservable for up to 2 people; open study space available on the 1st floor.

cards.title: School of Law Café
cards.subtitle: 765 Commonwealth Ave, 2nd Floor
cards.notes: Enjoy a bright, airy environment with floor-to-ceiling windows. While the library is restricted, the café is a popular spot for all students to work.
cards.short_summary: A spacious and naturally lit café area within the BU Law complex open for casual studying.
cards.evidence_claim: The School of Law Café on the second floor is a spacious, bright area with floor-to-ceiling windows used by students for studying.
cards.source_title: (Some of) The Amazing Places to Study on Campus - BU Blogs
cards.access_notes: Open to the general BU community; hours typically follow building operations.

cards.title: Computing & Data Sciences Nooks
cards.subtitle: 665 Commonwealth Ave
cards.notes: Explore the various nooks and open lounges in BU's newest landmark. The bottom two floors offer the best options for casual solo or group work.
cards.short_summary: Modern study lounges and nooks located within the 19-story 'Jenga' building.
cards.evidence_claim: The Duan Family Center for Computing & Data Sciences is open for learning and lounging, with study nooks on the bottom two floors.
cards.source_title: The Best Places to Study for Finals - Boston University
cards.access_notes: Open daily; Monday-Friday 7 AM - 10 PM, Weekends 8 AM - 10 PM.

cards.title: School of Theology Library
cards.subtitle: 745 Commonwealth Ave, 2nd Floor
cards.notes: Study in a historic setting featuring stained glass and a peaceful atmosphere. This library is known for being one of the quietest spots on campus.
cards.short_summary: A serene and historic library space known for its quiet environment and architectural beauty.
cards.evidence_claim: The School of Theology Library is located at 745 Commonwealth Ave and is recognized as a peaceful, quiet study location.
cards.source_title: School of Theology Library - Boston University
cards.access_notes: Open to all BU students; check website for specific seasonal hours.
